**Observation Log:**

[FACT] The user is trying to get more organized with their online activities.

[PREFERENCE] The user is looking for a tool to help keep track of social media platforms they have commented on and the conversations they have had.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hootsuite Insights is recommended as a tool to track social media conversations, including comments across multiple platforms.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sprout Social is another recommended tool that offers a "Conversations" feature to track and respond to comments, messages, and mentions.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Buffer is suggested as a social media scheduling tool that allows tracking and responding to comments and messages.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Agorapulse is mentioned as a platform that offers a "Social Inbox" feature for tracking and responding to comments and messages.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Google Sheets or Excel is suggested as a manual approach to track online conversations by creating a spreadsheet.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should consider the number of social media platforms, volume of conversations, budget, level of analytics needed, and comfort level with new tools before choosing a tool.

[TEMPORAL] The user commented on a friend's post about their new puppy last Wednesday morning.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hootsuite Insights is primarily designed for tracking conversations related to brands, keywords, or hashtags, not individual comments on specific posts.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instagram's API limitations restrict third-party tools from accessing certain data, including comments on individual posts unless the user is the post owner.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Manual methods to track specific conversations on Instagram include taking screenshots, saving posts in a note-taking app, or creating reminders in a calendar.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hootsuite can help track mentions of the user's brand or username, hashtag campaigns, and industry-related keywords.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hootsuite can provide insights on post engagement, follower growth, and top-performing content.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hootsuite can be used to schedule posts on Instagram, including for the user's daily writing prompt account.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] To schedule Instagram posts with Hootsuite, the user needs to connect their Instagram account, create a new post, and choose the date and time for publication.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hootsuite does not have a built-in feature to remind users to comment on specific posts, but the user can set up a workflow to monitor posts and create reminders in external tools.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Content Library feature in Hootsuite can help the user organize their Instagram content, including short poems written in response to daily prompts.
